narrative.coaching_note: Clean your hands right after you touch bed rail A or call button before you touch anything else. You touched bed rail A with your bare hand at 0.5 seconds, so your bare hand picked up contamination from that source. You then touched call button at 3.4 seconds and phone at 6.6 seconds, which moved contamination to call button and then to phone. You put gloves on at 10.9 seconds without cleaning your hands first, and later touched phone with your gloved hand at 19.3 seconds. Next time, clean your hands with alcohol rub before you put gloves on, and take gloves off and clean hands before touching things in the healthcare area. At the end, your bare hand, your gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, and phone were still contaminated.
narrative.audit_summary: Staged clip with MRSA source bed rail A. Transfers: bed rail A to bare hand at 0.5 seconds, bare hand to call button at 3.4 seconds, bare hand to phone at 6.6 seconds, and bed rail A to gloved hand at 11.1 seconds. Missed Moment 5 at 5.8 seconds (bare hand) and at 18.7 seconds (gloved hand). Hand hygiene compliance 0/2 overall and 0/2 for Moment 5; Moments 1, 2 and 4 had no opportunities. No hygiene events occurred; alcohol rub would be effective against MRSA. Glove use issues included donning at 10.9 seconds without prior hand hygiene and gloved contact with healthcare-area phone at 19.3 seconds. Contaminated at end: bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, phone. Disinfect bed rail A, call button, and phone. Use an EPA List H registered disinfectant (effective against MRSA).
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene at 5.8 seconds.
